matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a strong background in database administration, spanning over six years of experience across various platforms and technologies. Their expertise includes managing Oracle and MySQL databases, as well as working with AWS infrastructure for migration and management. The candidate has hands-on experience in backup strategies, performance tuning, cloning, security enhancements like implementing TDE (Transparent Data Encryption) and database auditing, and real-time data replication using tools such as RMAN, Crontab, and Oracle Golden Gate. Their technical skills are supported by a solid educational foundation in Civil Engineering, complemented by several industry-recognized certifications.
